correctness.rationale: For SPD 2x2 H and nondegenerate start, coordinate line-search maps (u,v) to (-cv/a,v) or (u,-cu/b), proving persistence when c != 0. Source RCGLS H-conjugacy makes the first switch from an active label a terminal spanning pair, while a duplicate label annihilates direction and a later switch restarts it. Four exact Markov transitions yield the displayed rational PGF. Algebraic differentiation gives means; symbolic and exhaustive Fraction checks confirm boundary cases. Coupon-collector diagonal law and nontermination of RCD are proved analytically. Limitations: exact arithmetic, generic start, iid positive probabilities.

value.rationale: This exact hitting-time classification for a new randomized least-squares solver resolves naturally motivated finite-termination and sampling-efficiency questions not determined by expected contraction. Its nontrivial active/inactive conjugacy mechanism yields an unexpectedly universal two-update jump for arbitrarily small nonzero coupling and a sharp divergence from ordinary randomized coordinate descent; the uniform optimum challenges norm-weighted sampling when exact solve count is the cost metric. It is a small but complete natural classification, not an arbitrary invariant or table recomputation.
